pooled_2023_27.label: All four seasons (2023-24 to 2026-27 to date)

segment_info.all: every player with a qualifying paired comparison (no games floor)
segment_info.top100: top 100 by PPG within the timespan (nested: includes top50/25/10)

legacy_compat: results is a hybrid object: results[home_away|b2b_second_vs_rested|b2b_first_vs_rested].by_scope[2025-26|2026-27|combined] keeps the old shape ({overall, segments:{position, age, experience, scorer_tier}}), results[<timespan>][<segment>] is the new nested structure. segments.scorer_tier (top_10, 11_25, 26_50, 51_100, rest by the unit's own-season PPG rank) is a DEPRECATED shim that exists only so the unchanged app keeps rendering; it is also in secondary[ts].scorer_tier for 2025_26, 2026_27 and pooled_2023_26 and is replaced by the nested segments (all/top100/top50/top25/top10).
metric_note: Points-focused. Every number is a per-player paired difference (condition A minus condition B), summarised across units. pts and minutes are per-game averages; per36 = 36 x sum(pts) / sum(minutes) in each condition.

definitions.games: Regular season only (game_id 002). NBA Cup group and knockout games count (they are 002); Cup final (006), playoffs, play-in excluded. Player-games with minutes > 0 only.
definitions.segments: Nested scorer segments ranked by PPG WITHIN the timespan: PPG = total points / games with minutes > 0 over the timespan's seasons. Only players with >= the timespan's min_games_floor games are ranked. top100/top50/top25/top10 = rank <= N (each contains the next). 'all' = every player with a qualifying comparison (no floor). Tiebreak: higher PPG, then more games, then lower numeric player_id.
definitions.min_games_floor_rule: 20 GP per full season (24% of 82); 40 for the 3-season pool; 50 for the 4-season pool (3 seasons + 2026-27 to date); 2026-27 to date = ceil(20/82 x median team games played) so the same share of the schedule as a full-season floor (4 at 13 team games). Top lists in 2026-27 are provisional.
definitions.home_away: Home = matchup 'vs.', away = '@'. Neutral-site games (isNeutral in BoxScoreSummaryV3: global games and Cup semifinals in Las Vegas) are excluded from home/away.
definitions.b2b_2nd: Team played the previous calendar day.
definitions.b2b_1st: Team plays the next calendar day and did not play the previous day.
definitions.rested: Team had 1+ days off before the game and does not play the next day. Season openers excluded.
definitions.rest_basis: Team schedule dates (the team the player played for in that game), Cup final (006) included as a played date. 2023-24/2024-25: ScheduleLeagueV2; 2025-26: curated 002+006 team games; 2026-27: full official schedule (so cutoff-night games know whether a game follows the next day).
definitions.units: A unit is a player-season with >= 3 games on each side of the comparison. Single-season timespans: one unit per player. Pooled timespans: one unit per player-season in the span (a player can contribute several), segment membership by his POOLED PPG rank; p-value from the paired t-test over units, CI from a bootstrap that resamples players (clusters). Per-player files (insights_player_splits / public/splits) instead pool the player's games across the span.
definitions.position: Primary (first-listed) position: that season's CommonTeamRoster, else PlayerIndex historical, else CommonPlayerInfo: G-F -> G, F-C -> F, C-F -> C.
definitions.age: Age on Feb 1 of the season from birth date (CommonTeamRoster BIRTH_DATE of that or another season; CommonPlayerInfo for players on no roster pull). Buckets: <=23, 24-27, 28-31, 32+.
definitions.experience: CommonTeamRoster EXP for that season ('R' = 0), never derived; null for players absent from that season's roster pull. Buckets: rookie, 1-3, 4-7, 8+.
definitions.stats: Mean and median of unit differences; two-sided one-sample (paired) t-test vs 0; percentile bootstrap 95% CI of the mean, 10000 resamples, seed 20261104.
definitions.fields: n_players, n_units, games_a / games_b (player-games in condition A / B among qualifying units), mean_a / mean_b (average of unit condition means), small_n = fewer than 20 units. null = not computable (never NaN).

caveats: 2026-27 is a very small sample (games through 2026-11-09, ~13 per team); treat its numbers as provisional; it only enters pooled_2023_27 and its own timespan.
Observational: B2B and venue are not randomised; coaches rest players around B2Bs (absent players are not in the data, which can bias toward healthier players).
Many comparisons are reported (6 timespans x 5 segments x 3 comparisons x 3 measures); expect some p < 0.05 by chance.

Segments are ranked on the same games the splits are measured on, so top10/top25 are selected on scoring (regression-to-the-mean risk is in the PPG level, not the home/away difference, but read tiny top-N cells with care).

sources.box_scores: stats.nba.com PlayerGameLogs (curated; 2026-27 incl. official pts/min corrections through the Nov 9 refresh)
sources.neutral_flag: BoxScoreSummaryV3 isNeutral for every game of all four seasons (fallback summaries carry 'neutral')
sources.rosters: CommonTeamRoster 2023-24 / 2024-25 / 2025-26 / 2026-27 (2026-27: 2026-11-10 pull first, 2026-11-04 pull fills players waived since)
